official.label: Lindy official product page
official.scope: Current official identity and cross-tool AI employee positioning. This is first-party product scope, not independent performance evidence.

official.label: Lindy official pricing
official.scope: Current free-credit trial, team credit tiers and account billing boundary. Checkout, tax and workspace-specific entitlements still require account verification.

official.label: Lindy official usage documentation
official.scope: Current shared credit-pool and heavy-task pause behavior. Actual task cost and reliability depend on configuration and were not tested by this directory.

independent.label: Cybernews hands-on Lindy review
independent.scope: Independent real-workflow testing found routine automations approachable while complex multi-step workflows and custom integrations remained limiting. Its historical pricing table is excluded because the live official pricing changed.
independent.nonDuplication: A hands-on workflow and usability assessment from an editorial publisher; it is not Lindy first-party material and does not supply the company-continuity signal.

independent.label: Crunchbase Lindy company profile
independent.scope: Independent company-profile data identifies Lindy as active and records Seed, Series A and Series B rounds. This supports organizational continuity only, not product capability or reliability.
independent.nonDuplication: A structured company-continuity and financing signal from a different domain and evidence method; it is not a product test and does not repeat Cybernews workflow testing.

strongSignals: Cybernews documents hands-on real-workflow testing: routine automations were approachable, while complex multi-step workflows and custom integrations showed limitations.
Crunchbase records an active company and three financing rounds through Series B; this is a continuity signal only, not product-performance proof.
supportingSignals: Three current first-party sources establish product identity, live pricing boundaries and shared-credit usage behavior.

rationale.en: Current official product, pricing and usage documentation plus two non-duplicative independent signals support a narrowly validated market-readiness decision. Hands-on editorial testing supports practical buyer relevance; company-profile data supports continuity. Neither source proves search demand, account-specific cost or production reliability.
rationale.cn: 当前官网产品、定价与用量文档，加上两条不重复的独立信号，足以支持范围受限的市场就绪判断。编辑实测支持实际采购相关性，公司资料支持持续运营；两者都不证明搜索需求、账户实际成本或生产可靠性。
rationale.zh: 當前官網產品、定價與用量文件，加上兩條不重複的獨立訊號，足以支援範圍受限的市場就緒判斷。編輯實測支援實際採購相關性，公司資料支援持續營運；兩者都不證明搜尋需求、帳戶實際成本或正式環境可靠性。
rationale.tw: 當前官網產品、定價與用量文件，加上兩條不重複的獨立訊號，足以支援範圍受限的市場就緒判斷。編輯實測支援實際採購相關性，公司資料支援持續營運；兩者都不證明搜尋需求、帳戶實際成本或正式環境可靠性。

marketValidation.limitation: Editorial readiness threshold only. Cybernews pricing claims were excluded as stale; Crunchbase is used only for company continuity. No verified search-volume estimate, account checkout, permissions audit or directory-run reliability test.
